system_deps: A running MVSim simulator (mvsim launch <world>.world.xml) on the host and port the sim backend names
install.notes: The sim backend (sim.py) is the package's own MVSim client and needs only pyzmq, a dependency of this package and never of the SDK; it encodes MVSim's protobuf messages itself (mvsim_wire.py, standard library), so neither protobuf nor the upstream python3-mvsim bindings are imported. The fake backend needs nothing beyond the SDK. Nothing was installed or run for this package.
